messages:
Maya - CS: @Emily thanks again for the call earlier. We're putting the customer-facing follow-up in this thread — short RCA, timeline, and next steps. Please flag anything to change.

IncidentBot: Incident #2345 detected — 2026-03-16 03:12 UTC. Symptom: elevated error rates and 503s for embedding endpoints. Pager sent to #eng-oncall.

Raj - SRE (oncall): Root cause (short): a rollout to the autoscaler service produced an incorrect node draining sequence. One GPU node failed to drain (kernel OOM on driver), which caused request queues to back up and runtime timeouts.

Lina - Support Eng: Confirmed metrics for the window: error rate peak ~17% (03:12–03:25 UTC). Majority of 503s from runtime layer that hit a full token-queue.

Raj - SRE (oncall): Mitigation steps taken: rolled back autoscaler config at 03:20 (rollback finished 03:24), brought up reserve pool at 03:25, enabled fallback routing to smaller model variant at 03:28. Traffic normalized by ~03:35.

Raj - SRE (oncall): Quick timeline (for customer):
```
03:12 UTC - Monitoring alert: embedding latency and 503s spike
03:14 UTC - Page delivered, oncall acknowledged
03:16 UTC - Investigation: autoscaler errors and node drain failures observed
03:20 UTC - Rollback started
03:24 UTC - Rollback complete; autoscaler reverted
03:25 UTC - Reserve pool scaled up + traffic rebalanced
03:28 UTC - Fallback routing enabled for affected routes
03:35 UTC - Error rates returned to baseline
```

Lina - Support Eng: Per-tenant check (example snippet we ran to estimate customer impact):
```
SELECT
  tenant_id,
  count(*) AS total_requests,
  sum(case when status = 503 then 1 else 0 end) AS errors_503
FROM requests
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-16 03:10' AND '2026-03-16 03:40'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY errors_503 DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

Raj - SRE (oncall): For BrightApps specifically: ~4.5% of their requests during the window had elevated latency; ~0.6% were 503s. Absolute impacted request count: ~2.1k.

Maya - CS: Draft customer-facing paragraph (please review):
"We’re very sorry for the disruption on 2026-03-16 between ~03:12–03:35 UTC. Root cause: an autoscaler rollout that interfered with node draining, which caused a subset of requests to error or experience high latency. We reverted the rollout, scaled reserves, and enabled fallbacks to restore normal service. We’ll follow up with a full RCA and a proposal for a remedial plan, including an SLA credit estimate."

Dave - AE: Thanks — can we publish the credit calc methodology in the follow-up? Emily asked specifically for how credits are computed.

Raj - SRE (oncall): Yes — we'll provide the tenant-level error counts and the formula. Example: SLA credit = min(1.0, impacted_request_ratio / 0.05) * monthly_commit * credit_multiplier (details in email). I'll hand off numbers to @Dave.

Lina - Support Eng: I'll attach sanitized logs and the per-tenant CSV to the support ticket after removing IPs/keys.

Maya - CS: Proposed next steps: 1) Send formal customer email with timeline + apology by EOD today. 2) Schedule a joint postmortem call (BrightApps requested Wed morning). 3) Provide SLA credit calc to BrightApps by EOD tomorrow. 4) Ops/Eng remediation plan and ETA.

Raj - SRE (oncall): Preventative actions (engineering): add pre-rollout drain health check to autoscaler job, block autoscaler rollouts without canary for 24h, add CI gating that verifies drain completes on a node-level in staging, increase reserve pool by 20% during canary windows, and add an embeddings synthetic canary hitting the same model path. I'll open the RFC and link here.

Emily (BrightApps): Thanks — we appreciate the quick follow-up. Wed morning postmortem works. We want the credit calc upfront so we can prep finance.

Maya - CS: Noted. @Dave will send the credit calc. @Raj and @Lina will attach logs and open the eng RFC. I'll draft the customer email now and post in this thread for sign-off before sending. :wave:

Dave - AE: I'll calculate and post the credit estimate in this thread by 17:00 UTC tomorrow.

Raj - SRE (oncall): I'll follow up in #eng-releases with the rollout-block rule once I open the RFC.

Lina - Support Eng: Support ticket updated with error CSV and sanitized log bundle. Ticket #9342.

Maya - CS: Thanks all — I'll pin the draft email here in ~30m for one-touch approval. :white_check_mark:
